scope: Legacy fixed-reference valuation-core timing window; not a certified full-stack V3.11 backtest.
observed_tradeoff_sentence: Over the tested window, moving equity exposure added 0.16 pp/year of return and 1.0 pp of additional drawdown.
decision_relevant_60_40_sentence: Against a pre-declared 60/40 policy over the same window, the dynamic model changed CAGR by -0.25 pp/year and maximum drawdown by +0.15 pp.

ex_post_realised_mean_static.name: Ex-post realised-mean static
ex_post_realised_mean_static.note: Uses the full sample realised mean equity weight. Useful for beta removal but unavailable to an investor at sample start.

timing_residual_effective_sample.method: Bartlett-style positive-autocorrelation design effect; diagnostic only

fixed_60_40_policy.name: Fixed 60/40 policy
fixed_60_40_policy.note: Pre-declared policy null fixed at 60% equity for the entire return window.

timing_residual_effective_sample.method: Bartlett-style positive-autocorrelation design effect; diagnostic only

expanding_mean_investable.name: Expanding-mean investable policy
expanding_mean_investable.note: At each decision, target equity equals the mean of valuation targets observed through that decision; no future target weights are used.

timing_residual_effective_sample.method: Bartlett-style positive-autocorrelation design effect; diagnostic only

comparator_beta_signature.interpretation: Across these three comparator weights, excess CAGR falls as comparator equity rises and is near zero around the dynamic strategy's own mean exposure. That is the geometry expected when most return differences are equity beta and residual timing content is small. With only three dependent portfolio constructions this is descriptive, not an independent statistical test.

observed_effect_scale.interpretation: Do not read these horizons literally. They show that the observed effect is far too small to justify a claim that merely waiting longer will validate it. Prospective evidence is useful for detecting a materially larger edge if one emerges and documenting its absence otherwise.
observed_effect_scale.warning: This scaling assumes the observed effect, variance and serial-dependence structure remain stationary; that assumption is not credible over century-scale horizons.

governance: The ex-post mean comparator remains valid for beta-removal diagnostics but is explicitly not investable. Promotion claims should also survive investable nulls; no result here changes live parameters automatically.
